build_fp16_optimizer: build an FP16 optimizer by calling FP16Optimizer.build_optimizer with a DictConfig and model parameters
build_memory_efficient_fp16_optimizer: build a memory efficient FP16 optimizer using MemoryEfficientFP16Optimizer.build_optimizer with config and params
build_fp32_params: build FP32 parameter copies from FP16 params using _FP16OptimizerMixin.build_fp32_params with flatten option
backward_with_loss_scaling: compute scaled gradients by calling the FP16Optimizer backward method with a loss tensor
clip_grad_norm_fp16: clip gradient norms and update the dynamic loss scaler via FP16Optimizer.clip_grad_norm with max_norm
